700 tests, 698 pass, 2 fail.

Both fails in `auth/tokens.test.js`:

- **`refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token`** — `auth/tokens.test.js:400` (log line 302, slot test_300)
- **`sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback`** — `auth/tokens.test.js:650` (log line 553, slot test_550)

Notes:
- No stack traces or assertion diffs in log — only FAIL line plus test name. Log has no summary/tally line at end either; counts above from my own tally of lines.
- First one is a security bug, not flake: revoked token accepted on refresh = revocation not enforced. Prioritize.
- Second suggests cleanup runs outside transaction, or rollback not covered by cleanup path.
- No other FAIL, skip, or timeout markers anywhere in the 702 lines.
